title: Reduce bounded NTT temporary storage from 17,920 to 1,282 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Reduce the fixed 512-point bounded NTT multiplier's owned temporary storage by 16,638 words, answering Open next question 2 of David Ganz's #5466.

```diff
-temporary words:     17,920
+temporary words:      1,282
 static instructions: 507,701
```

Claim type: scoped program-refinement proof with a finite source-bound certificate. Address renaming preserves every opcode, branch target and per-input execution count. It preserves operands and exterior memory, including abandoned old temporary addresses, and returns the smaller owned arena and fixed scratch to zero. The original 20 scratch words and 513 output words are additional in both versions.

The new allocation and simulation proof build on #5466's cited bounded multiplication theorem. They do not audit or re-prove that theorem. Interval coloring and simulation are classical; the contribution is their checked refinement of this concrete construction. Original source bytes and predecessor credit remain unchanged.

## Evidence

- Before: 17,920 logical temporaries in the pinned original template. After: 1,282 physical cells, with a matching closed-interval overlap witness at instruction 140274.
- Nine complete static allocation/renaming certificates, 280 paired dirty-memory executions and eight rejection controls pass. Every single hexadecimal-digit pair is included. Larger templates exercise maximal, zero and unit patterns; their outputs agree with direct integer multiplication.
- Normal and optimized warning-strict direct checks pass locally in 2.39 and 2.29 seconds. Both registered commands pass; the complete registered replay takes 4.91 seconds locally.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes at `b1b8ce5622a01a8e818defc25c836a440568d707` for 15 package/input files. Official export integrity and an optimized Git-free replay of that export pass. A separate read-only review found no correctness blockers in the new proof and transformation.

From the repository root, with CPython 3.12.15 and the standard library:

```sh
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/wordram-live-storage
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/wordram-live-storage/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/wordram-live-storage/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/wordram-live-storage --check-source-history
```

Expected output: `PASS_WORDRAM_LIVE_STORAGE`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

## Limitations

The 1,282-word minimum applies only to the declared whole closed-lifetime allocation rule. It is not an unrestricted storage lower bound. The all-input endpoint conclusion uses the original bounded multiplier theorem as a premise and the new written simulation; finite execution examples do not enumerate all 1,024-bit operands. The nine certified balanced templates are not a census of every asymmetric length pair. Offline generation costs are separate from emitted runtime instructions. No new kappa, selected consumer, selected-supplier admission, complete machine formalization or independent human/formal proof-kernel review is claimed. Lean, Docker, the selected cold replay and the approximate FFT backend were not run.

## Open next questions

- Remove redundant final zeroings with a label-aware rewrite and a complete new instruction count. This PR preserves every original instruction.
- Consider split lifetimes or last-use operand consumption. Either changes the allocation model and needs its own simulation and lower-bound scope.

## Related open work

Refreshed the titles and bodies of this account's open PRs created since the advance CLAIM, including #5887 through #5893. None studies the fixed #5466 NTT temporary arena or computes this allocation quantity.

- #5880 studies reversible Gaussian overwrite information storage under a different operation model and does not supply this allocation.
- #5813 studies Gaussian spectral/precision compilation rather than the bounded literal NTT program.
- #5890 sharpens the denominator debt of #5813's Gaussian bulk. It does not change NTT temporary lifetimes or compute the same storage count.
- #5893 minimizes migrations between two reusable eligible resources. This PR statically renames direct-address temporaries and charges no migrations; the models and computed quantities differ.

None is used as a premise, and no additional computations were run to compare their results.
## CI notes

For commit `b1b8ce5622a01a8e818defc25c836a440568d707`, [run 40495644209](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40495644209) failed in `plan` at **Onboarding helper tests**. All ten failure/error entries are in `tests/test_research_current_assignment.py`; the final summary is `FAILED (failures=8, errors=2, skipped=22)`.

The two errors are `KeyError: 'follow_up_steps'` and `KeyError: 'catalog_first_step'`. The eight failure entries concern the frozen-card count (`0 != 16`), missing-helper/reference rejection, and sparse-reference receipts. This is the reported shared onboarding failure on main `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`; the test file and shared implementation are unchanged by this PR. The same `plan` failure and skipped `replay` are also present on #5885. No shared tests or code were changed to address it.

**`replay` was skipped. Hosted replay has not certified this package; only the local package checks reported above have run.** No hosted scientific success is claimed.
## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Adds only `research/wordram-live-storage/`.

**Blast Radius:** research
